purpose: Read-only exhaustive audit of paired 2022/2023 prediction artifacts to find overlooked development axes; no candidate is eligible without a separate provenance and leakage audit.
pair_rule: same filename stem ending in _2022.npz and _2023.npz
array_rule: same one-dimensional finite floating key, exact y and row_index alignment, all values in [0,1]
route: R only; exact-C remains unchanged on F
ranking: largest minimum full-score gain over both years and all three comparisons; tie by minimum R gain
